description: Fossés 2013 : site de Kervidy (ORE AgrHyS) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geosas.fr. Map of the ditches of the INRA study site of Kervidy-Naizin. This map was lifted in 2013. Only one culture is informed this year. The vector layer was created from field observations made in June by Lucie CARRERA, Rémi DUPAS and Guillaume HUMBERT. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Ditches 2013: Kervidy website (ORE AgrHyS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Fossés, Morbihan, Naizin, données ouvertes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
